chapter: Joining Earl Hines and the Grand Terrace
title: The Grand Terrace room and its piano
summary: The club was redone in silver; Wilson recalls the huge German grand.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Well, I guess he was one of the main reasons for the Grand Terrace's success.
If not the main reason. What kind of place was the Grand Terrace? I mean, was it ornate, or a lot of decorations?

Yeah, well, at first it was just like the old style cabaret, you know, a lot of drapes and things around there. And then they remodeled, and modernized the joint. So then it was did out in beautiful silver, new band-stand, everything. But it was a beautiful place.
Yeah, oh, they had, yeah. They had a German piano, don't hear of it much.
Something like that. Becker's in it. Beck-something. Lord, it was long, about a block long. Baby grand. Wasn't a baby grand, block-long grand.
